text: Hello, I'm really sorry to message so late, I'm a foster carer and I've only had him a few weeks so I'm probably being overcautious. He's 4 and his temperature is 38.1. He was sick once earlier this evening but he's kept all his drinks down since then. He's also got some little red spots on his legs and arms, but they're mosquito bites. We were out in the garden all day yesterday and I saw them biting him, and he's been scratching them. I just want to check I'm doing the right thing. Sorry for taking up your time
